steps.offscreen: (async () => { const m = await import(chrome.runtime.getURL("dist/common/packstore.js")); const all = await m.allMeta(); let b = 0, ahead = 0, used = 0; for (const v of all.values()) { b += v.bytes; if (v.ahead) ahead++; if (v.uses) used++; } return JSON.stringify({ packs: all.size, mb: +(b / 1048576).toFixed(1), ahead, used, usedIds: [...all].filter(([, v]) => v.uses).map(([k, v]) => k.replace(/-[0-9a-f]{12}$/, "") + ":" + v.uses) }); })()
